caption_latex: Peer-to-peer SDWSN edge collaboration architecture with task-triggered Global Network election. A task stream activates one SDN controller as the temporary Global Network for the current task, while the remaining controllers act as autonomous worker agents. Each agent contains actor, critic, and target networks and governs a local edge-server domain. East--west bridges support inter-controller coordination and gradient exchange without introducing a permanent centralized controller.

Training architecture of PPO-bounded asynchronous actor--critic learning. The Global Network maintains actor and critic models, while distributed workers interact with edge environments, cache transitions in replay buffers, upload gradients, and receive synchronized parameters. The highlighted worker illustrates the replay-based update path in which PPO clipping, bounded replay, and the $\mathcal{O}(\varepsilon)$ off-policy error bound constrain stale-policy samples from task workloads, link states, and edge-resource observations.

A3C-PPO training loop with adaptive reward feedback. Environmental observations $s_t$ are processed by the Global Network and distributed workers to generate an action $a_t$. The environment response is evaluated by a learned or designed reward model $R_\phi(s_t,a_t)$, which returns the scalar reward $R_t$ to the workers. Worker gradients update the Global Network asynchronously, while the PPO clipping objective constrains policy changes through $L^{\mathrm{CLIP}}(\theta)$.

Detailed ECA-MARL dataflow for SDWSN edge collaboration. SDN global views and task information form the model input to the Global Network, where actor and critic networks estimate the offloading policy and state value. Worker controllers collect experience from their local environments, update replay pools, upload gradients, and receive synchronized parameters. The reward model encodes state and action features, fuses them into a scalar reward $R_t$, and feeds the advantage calculation used to update the global actor--critic parameters.
